line_records.text: Owner approved exactly **Ultra Light → Very Light → Light → Medium-Light → Medium → Medium-Dark → Dark**, in Title Case. The original five categories keep their meanings and starting priors. Former `Light-Medium` maps only as a legacy equivalent of **Medium-Light**. New Ultra Light and Very Light start from prior Light recipes, without invented scientific precision. An empty/unknown roast remains possible. Neither roaster brands nor unlabeled visual roast meters are evidence of a particular category. Personal successful shots/actual taste continue to outrank a roast guess.
